Directory research 2026-10-04: Our work network blocks winery websites, so we used the winery's official online store (sanninovineyard.orderport.net), which carries the same footer details, plus Google Maps. Instagram: the store links instagram.com/sanninovineyard, while search results name @sannino_vineyard (the TikTok handle); we recorded the one the winery links, please double-check. Search summaries also mention Friday evening music (8-10 PM, $10 cover) that we could not confirm. Hours note: service ends 30 minutes before closing. No venue photos: the store only has product and tasting close-ups, and the main site is blocked for us. Additional emails on the store: events@ and innkeeper@sanninovineyard.com.
hours: Mon-Thu 12-6 PM; Fri 12-7 PM; Sat 11 AM-7 PM; Sun 11 AM-6 PM
description: A family-run winery and tasting house on County Road 48 in Cutchogue on the North Fork, with a small bed and breakfast. It has live music on Sunday afternoons and holds jazz nights.
